claim_firewall: No claim that current reforms prevent another Ida.
No claim that current police performance is better.
No claim that a 2026 system would respond better.
No claim that Ida would have had a different outcome.

comparison_universes.2025: Official Data.NOLA CFS 2025 endpoint 4xwx-sfte and EPR 2025 endpoint agqi-9adb.
comparison_universes.2026: Official Data.NOLA CFS 2026 endpoint es9j-6y5d; no catalog-listed EPR 2026 located as of 2026-08-11.
comparison_universes.dashboard_ecosystem: Official NOPD dashboard directory and Response Times Power BI report/model; Calls for Service and Crime Trends link resolves to a third-party Community Crime Map and was not treated as official primary data.
comparison_universes.locked_2021: Official Data.NOLA CFS 2021 endpoint 3pha-hum9 plus locked public CAD-EPR and M7D topology/decomposition artifacts.

decision_basis: The current public dashboard adds useful queryable derived/model fields, including candidate en-route and disposition-multiplicity signals, but the annual raw schema is essentially the locked 2021 schema and the new fields lack common semantic/history bindings. Queue, availability, priority history, and continuity remain outside the public measurement regime.

L1_public_topology_detection.change_from_2021: No material primitive change; create/dispatch/arrival/close topology remains public.

L2_within_disposition_stage_localization.change_from_2021: Candidate improvement from queryable en-route duration and All Dispositions, but definitions, ordering, and history are unqualified.

L3_internal_public_bridge_separation.change_from_2021: Public surfaces can be compared, but internal state and publication transformations are not exposed; 2026 EPR is missing from the catalog.

L4_queue_availability_reconstruction.change_from_2021: No contraction: no queue, calls-holding, unit-status, or availability time series.

L5_priority_history_reconstruction.change_from_2021: Current documentation and dashboard flags clarify endpoint contrasts, but the 2021 schema already exposed both endpoints and no history was added.

L6_continuity_fallback_reconstruction.change_from_2021: Policy describes fallback routes, but realized routing, callback, uptime, and failover states remain unobserved.

L7_cross_module_propagation.change_from_2021: Public priority, stage, disposition, and 2025 EPR endpoints can be cross-tabulated, but Q and C states are absent and no full B-Q-P-C path is identified.

identified_set_comparison.common_observable_endpoint_parameters: Conditional on a maintained frozen common-semantic mapping, I_2026(theta | Y_Ida) = I_2021(theta | Y_Ida) after schema normalization when the dashboard field is a deterministic function of InitialPriority, Priority, stage timestamps, signal endpoints, disposition endpoint, or SelfInitiated.
identified_set_comparison.dashboard_only_candidate_fields: En-route seconds and All Dispositions are publicly queryable, but no authoritative common semantic map to the locked 2021 estimand was located. Treating their labels as a proof of common meaning would violate the semantic-binding rule.
identified_set_comparison.queue_availability_priority_history_cont: No strict containment proved; the same decisive latent state variables remain absent.

m8d_realized_witness_regime.interpretation: Current public semantic enrichment does not open any realized M8D B-Q-P-C structural witness module.

B.reason: The 2025 public CFS-EPR item link supplies downstream public-record context. It is not the M8 internal/public dispatch bridge U_dispatch -> D_pub, and no public internal-event/public-export reconciliation is available.

C.reason: APR, callbacks, and fallback routes are documented as policy semantics, but no public realized route, callback, uptime, or failover state was located.

P.reason: Initial/final priority endpoints, suffix semantics, and a change flag are public; transition times, actors, reasons, multiplicity, and event history are not. No formal PARTIAL_OUTER priority-history set is proved.

Q.reason: Create/dispatch/arrival/close endpoints and response-time derivatives describe public record stages, but they do not construct a queue reachable set or expose calls holding, unit availability, or effective capacity.
